core: The working definition: nursing and allied health foundations as the shared entry-level knowledge and practical skills that nurses, nursing assistants, and allied health professionals learn first (attributed to OpenStax Fundamentals of Nursing)
The professions that train on the foundation: registered nurses, licensed practical nurses, nursing assistants, and allied health roles, each with a one-line description
The five pillars of the shared foundation: safety, communication, assessment, medications, and infection control, each named with one line
Why it matters: competent care rests on shared basics
The care team connection: professionals work together (full treatment owned by the sibling topic healthcare-team-roles)
The learning path: skills build step by step, foundation first
The honest framing: foundations are noticed only when missing

claims.claim: Nursing and allied health foundations are the shared entry-level knowledge and practical skills that nurses, nursing assistants, and allied health professionals learn first and build their work on; OpenStax's Fundamentals of Nursing frames its own subject as the foundational knowledge and practical expertise essential for delivering holistic and patient-centered care, covering the roles and responsibilities of the nursing profession, the healthcare environment, and the application of critical thinking and evidence-based practice.
Registered nurses (RNs) provide and coordinate patient care and educate patients and the public about various health conditions.
Licensed practical nurses (LPNs) and licensed vocational nurses (LVNs) provide basic medical care.
Nursing assistants provide basic care and help patients with activities of daily living.

The healthcare occupational group includes technical and therapeutic allied health roles such as respiratory therapists, who care for patients who have trouble breathing, and medical assistants, who complete administrative and clinical tasks such as scheduling appointments and taking vital signs.
Entry-level clinical skills curricula cover basic procedures from hygiene and mobility to vital signs assessment and medication administration, building on the NCSBN clinical judgment model.

Introductory pharmacology for nurses teaches the fundamental understanding of the therapeutic use of drugs so that nurses can administer medications safely and provide medication education to clients and their caregivers.

OpenStax's Fundamentals of Nursing develops critical communication skills through simulated patient interactions and emphasizes the Quality and Safety Education for Nurses (QSEN) framework to prepare students for real-world clinical environments.
CDC guidance on hand hygiene in healthcare settings centers on protecting patients and healthcare providers from infection.
Health care education builds in layers: entry-level programs teach the shared foundation first, and each profession adds its own depth and specialty on top.

conflictingEvidence.issue: Is the foundation identical for every profession?
positions: Entry-level curricula across nursing assistant, LPN, and RN programs overlap heavily in the first semester (safety, communication, basic care skills).
Program length and depth differ sharply: RN entry is typically a bachelor's or associate degree, while nursing assistants complete state-approved training programs.
conflictingEvidence.resolution: The lesson states the foundation is shared in kind but varies in depth by role: every profession learns the same five pillars, while each program's length, depth, and license differ.

conflictingEvidence.issue: 'Allied health' has no single official definition.
positions: BLS groups healthcare occupations individually rather than under one 'allied health' heading.
Programs, employers, and textbooks use 'allied health' as a common umbrella for the technical and therapeutic roles around nursing and medicine.
conflictingEvidence.resolution: The lesson uses 'allied health' as an umbrella term and names example roles from BLS descriptions (respiratory therapists, medical assistants) rather than presenting a fixed official list.
